sentences.text:
Hence, the following ad-interim order :-
 ORDER (a) By way of ad-interim order, in the event of his arrest, the Applicant - Manoj Madhukar Gholap in connection with C.R.No.837/2022 registered with Kasturba Marg Police Station shall be released on bail on furnishing P.R. bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- with one or two sureties of the like amount.

(b) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to Court or any Police Officer and should not tamper with evidence.
(c) The Applicant shall report to the Police Station from 13/7/2022 to 15/7/2022 between 2.00 p.m to 5.00 p.m and render all his co-operation to the Investigating Officer.
